tools.source: interlock host tools go-duration-days --role worker --host claude-code

sessions.final_text:
`GetDuration` now accepts a standalone `d` unit, so `30d` reads as `720h0m0s`. It also takes fractions like `1.5d`. The `repro` check (`sh checks/days.sh`) and `go test ./...` both pass when run through `interlock check run`.

- **Change:** `getters.go` has a new `parseDuration` helper. It handles values of the form `<number>d` and passes everything else to `time.ParseDuration` unchanged. The existing second-count path (`90`) is untouched.
- **Rejected inputs:** `1d12h` is still an error, because combining `d` with other units isn't supported. A value too large to fit in a duration, such as `9999999999d`, is also an error.
- **Tests and docs:** I added cases for these in `getters_test.go` and one sentence to `README.md`.
- **Claims:** I recorded claims for `repro` (observed), `regression` (tested) and `spec` (tested). `repro` and `spec` still need the independent verifier.

- **repro**: Holds (observed). `interlock check run --criterion repro` passed on tree ed2f963 and printed `ok: 30d is 720h0m0s`.
- **spec**: Holds (tested). `TestGetDuration` passes: `30d` is 720h and `1.5d` is 36h, while `1m30s` and `90` read as before. `1d12h` and `9999999999d` are rejected. Anything without a standalone `d` suffix goes to `time.ParseDuration` unchanged.
- **regression**: Holds (tested). `go test ./...` passed on the same tree.

checks_run: git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; interlock check run --criterion repro; interlock check run --criterion regression; git diff 3e6d67d --stat; git diff 3e6d67d -- getters.go
git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; git diff 3e6d67d -- getters_test.go | head -50; go test -run Duration -v ./ 2>&1 | tail -30

interlock assess add --criterion repro --strength observed --ref "interlock check run --criterion repro" --note "check passed on tree ed2f963: ok: 30d is 720h0m0s"
interlock assess add --criterion spec --strength tested --ref "go test -run Duration -v ./" --note "TestGetDuration passes: 30d=720h, 1.5d=36h, existing 1m30s and 90 unchanged, 1d12h and 9999999999d rejected; non-d inputs go to time.ParseDuration unchanged"
interlock assess add --criterion regression --strength tested --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "go test ./... passes on tree ed2f963"

sed -i 's/^\t"fmt"$/\t"fmt"\n\t"math"/' getters.go
python3 - <<'E'
p='getters_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('never = soon\n','never = soon\nretention = 30d\nhalf = 1.5d\nmixed = 1d12h\nhuge = 9999999999d\n')
s=s.replace('''"grace": 90 * time.Second}''','''"grace": 90 * time.Second, "retention": 720 * time.Hour, "half": 36 * time.Hour}''')
s=s.replace('''	if _, err := c.GetDuration("limits", "never"); err == nil {
		t.Error("GetDuration(never) should fail")
	}
''','''	for _, key := range []string{"never", "mixed", "huge"} {
		if _, err := c.GetDuration("limits", key); err == nil {
			t.Errorf("GetDuration(%s) should fail", key)
		}
	}
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='README.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("`Lookup` takes","`GetDuration` takes Go durations (`1m30s`), whole seconds (`90`) or days (`30d`, 24 hours each). `Lookup` takes")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
gofmt -l .; go test ./... 2>&1|tail -5
interlock check run --criterion repro; interlock check run --criterion regression

interlock claim add --criterion repro --strength observed --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion repro" --note "checks/days.sh passes: 30d is 720h0m0s"
interlock claim add --criterion regression --strength tested --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "go test ./... passes, including new day cases"
interlock claim add --criterion spec --strength tested --tree auto --ref "go test ./..." --note "TestGetDuration covers 30d, 1.5d; 1d12h and overflow rejected; prior cases unchanged"
